channel.title: ParkShelf for Windows
channel.description: Most recent changes with links to updates

item.title: ParkShelf 1.0.2
item.description:
• Fixed unintended window restoration on hover after undocking a parked window or parking a new window onto the shelf.
  • Scoped drag-out gestures per shelf card and required an active left mouse button press before undocking.
  • Added individual browser tab parking when dragging a tab out of Chrome or Edge onto the shelf.
  • Included ParkShelf.pri XAML resource index and hardened Windows 10 LTSC titlebar setup.
